CAMPD/CEMS resolves that at UNIT grain, and the derive now removes it: heat_rate = (PLHTIAN + CHPCHTI) * (1 - dark_fuel_share) / PLNGENAN. A SHARE, never an MMBtu subtraction, so it needs CEMS's fuel COMPOSITION to be representative and never CEMS's LEVEL to equal eGRID's; the denominator is unchanged, zero free parameters, no threshold, byte no-op wherever no dark fuel exists.
